name: CLT Lab
desc: A central-limit-theorem lab: dice-count and sample-count sliders drive the histogram of dice sums, with the theoretical normal curve overlaid.
controls: Dice-per-roll and sample-count sliders, three dice presets (d6/d4/d20), roll button, normal-curve toggle; keys 1–3 switch dice, Space rolls
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
